    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group. Add `model` to a phase entry when that phase uses a specific model override.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, model?: string, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

1	# Audit Chain
2	
3	A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, audit, transaction-graph.
4	
5	Run with: python3 demo.py
6	Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
7	
8	## Scope
9	
10	实现按租户分区的追加审计日志：每条记录包含租户、顺序号、事件和前一条摘要，读取方可以离线校验完整历史并定位第一个损坏的位置。追加必须拒绝错误的前序状态，校验结果要明确区分缺失、顺序错误和摘要错误；日志格式保持可迁移，不依赖网络服务或远端锚定。
11	
12	租户身份按稳定的 JSON 数据身份划分（`json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)`）：对象键顺序不影响身份，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 是四个互不相干的租户；append、verify、verify_all 共用同一套分区语义。
13	
14	输入与读取都遵循标准 JSON 边界：append 的 tenant 和 event 只能由 null、布尔值、有限整数/浮点数、字符串、数组和键为字符串的对象递归组成，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串键及无法无歧义编码的值一律抛出 `ValueError`（先于任何追加动作，不写入任何字节）。verify 的 tenant 参数采用同一定义：非法值在读取历史或触碰路径之前抛出 `ValueError`（不泄露 TypeError/RecursionError 或 JSON 编码异常），已损坏的文件与非法 tenant 同时出现时同样是 `ValueError` 优先且字节不变；合法 tenant 的校验结果（missing/sequence/digest 及 expected_count 语义）保持不变。verify/verify_all 以同一规则解释历史：包含重复对象键、NaN/Infinity/-Infinity 或其他非标准 JSON 内容的物理行按 missing 类损坏处理并停在首次出现处。
15	
16	同一路径可被多个线程或进程同时读写而仍保持单一可验证历史：append 在整个"读取最新状态—计算 seq/prev/hash—追加"区间持有排他文件锁（`flock`，无第三方依赖），因此每条记录都基于其真正落盘前的最新完整状态计算，任何调用都不会覆盖既有字节；verify/verify_all 持共享锁读取，只会看到某次追加之前或之后完整自洽的文件视图，绝不会把写了一半的记录报成损坏。历史一旦损坏，并发 append 仍以相同的 tenant/seq/line/reason（missing、sequence、digest 之一）抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 且不改动文件。旧版 JSONL 文件格式不变，可继续直接验证。
17	
18	`append_batch(tenant, events)` 一次提交一组同租户事件：events 必须是列表（空列表直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不改动字节；其他类型一律 `ValueError`），租户与列表中每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界。成功时按输入顺序分配连续 seq——首条接在该租户当前链末（prev 为提交前最后一条记录的摘要），后续逐条引用批次内前一条摘要——并在同一次排他租约内以一个字节块整体追加，因此整批对其他追加/校验是一个不可分割的可见结果：同租户追加只能整体落在批前或批后，不同租户仍可交错且各自从 1 计数。落盘为每行一个 JSON 对象，与逐条调用 append 产生的字节和 verify/verify_all 计数、摘要、首个错误位置完全一致；扫描到与 append 相同的首个损坏点时抛出同样字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）的 `AuditChainStateError`，失败不留任何部分记录。
19	
20	`append_if_head(tenant, event, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是带前序断言的单条条件追加：调用方给出链头应有的记录数和末条摘要，只有二者与租约内实际读到的链头**同时**相等时才追加下一条。`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool`、负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链的期望摘要使用现有 `ZERO`。tenant、event 继续沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；所有非法值（含布尔计数、负数计数、格式不正确的摘要）都在读取日志或创建文件之前以 `ValueError` 结束，不创建、不修改日志。成功时返回值与 append 完全相同（同一记录 dict、同样的五个字段、seq、prev 与摘要算法），落盘字节与对相同历史调用 append 逐字节一致。断言格式合法但与当前链头不符时抛出新增的 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash` 五个字段，且 `reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`；`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`，历史为空（日志不存在、为空或只含其他租户记录）时按同一规则比较，失败调用不写入任何字节——对尚不存在的日志作出非空断言尤其不会创建日志文件。历史损坏时沿用 `AuditChainStateError`：tenant、seq、line、reason 语义与 append/verify/export 完全一致，reason 仍只取 missing、sequence、digest，错误优先级与文件字节不变，且状态错误优先于冲突判定（不会拿不可验证的链去比较断言）。校验、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：日志已存在时使用与 append 相同的数据文件排他锁；日志尚不存在时，排他目录取锁（普通 append 创建文件时同样短暂持有该锁）覆盖"探测不存在—空链比较—创建文件"整段，且文件只在断言获胜后才被创建，加锁顺序始终是目录锁先于文件锁，不会与普通 append 死锁。因此并发提交同一个链头时至多一个成功，其余调用都在锁内观察到获胜者写入的新链头并得到确定的冲突异常（actual_* 反映获胜后的真实计数与末条摘要）。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果、JSONL 格式、租户身份区分及离线行为保持不变。
21

38	`read_tenant(tenant, start_seq=1, page_size=None)` 是只读的按租户分页读取入口：返回按该租户 `seq` 升序排列的记录列表，每项保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个现有字段及其磁盘原值；列表只包含目标租户，其他租户的交错记录既不出现也不改变分页顺序（分页只按目标租户自己的 1..count 计数）。`start_seq` 必须是大于等于 1 的普通整数（拒绝 bool、浮点及其他类型），缺省 1 表示从第一条开始；`page_size` 必须是正的普通整数或 `None`，`None`（缺省）表示读到链尾。起始序号超过当前条数、或末页不足 page_size 都不是错误：返回相应后缀，可能为 `[]`。tenant、start_seq、page_size 在读取任何历史之前全部校验——tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 相同的标准 JSON 边界，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串对象键、循环容器及布尔/其他非标准值统一抛 `ValueError`，非法分页参数同样抛 `ValueError`，且不创建、不修改任何文件。读取在单次只读共享锁快照中完成（与 verify/export 相同）：先以与 `verify(tenant)` 完全相同的 JSON 身份与摘要规则扫描该租户从第一条到链尾的完整历史，整份快照对该租户有效后才在内存中截取所请求页；因此并发追加只能让本次结果对应某次追加之前或之后的完整快照，绝不会出现撕裂页，且即使请求页位于损坏点之前，缺字段、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON、序号不连续、前序摘要不匹配或当前摘要重算不一致都会使整个调用抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 而绝不返回已验证前缀，定位字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）与 verify/append/export_tenant 完全一致，reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest 并优先报告首次发现的位置。目标租户不存在或日志不存在视为空链，成功返回 `[]`。该入口不写分页缓存、不改动原始字节、不依赖网络；append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant 的签名、返回值、异常边界、并发一致性及可迁移日志格式保持不变。
39	
40	`verify_bytes(data, tenant, expected_count=None)` 与 `verify_all_bytes(data)` 是纯内存离线校验入口：调用方把 JSONL 历史的原始 `bytes` 直接传入（`export_tenant` 导出的单租户字节，或包含交错租户的完整日志均可），入口绝不读取、创建或修改构造器所指向的路径，也不依赖网络、远端锚定或其他服务；结果只依据传入快照，调用期间不修改 `data`。两个入口复用与 verify/verify_all 完全相同的 JSON 标准化、租户身份与摘要算法逐行校验，因此返回结构、reason 分类（missing/sequence/digest）、`at` 口径、租户首次出现顺序与计数与文件入口逐字节一致；空 `bytes` 是成功的空历史（`verify_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "count": 0}`，`verify_all_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "tenants": []}`），且不创建任何文件。空行、非对象、缺字段、重复键、非标准数字（NaN/Infinity/溢出数）、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON 解析失败一律按 missing 处理，能定位的物理行使用行号；seq 不连续为 sequence，prev 或 hash 不符为 digest；其他租户的坏行同样会被发现，且更早的错误优先。`verify_bytes` 的 expected_count 短缺报 missing、超额报 sequence，与 verify 同口径；`data` 不是 `bytes`（含 `bytearray`/`str` 等）、tenant 越过标准 JSON 边界（NaN/Infinity、非字符串键、循环容器等），或 expected_count 不是 `None` 以外的非负整数（`bool` 同样拒绝）时，在任何解析之前抛出 `ValueError`，不泄漏底层解析异常。export_tenant 生成的字节写回另一个 `AuditChain` 后，文件校验与内存校验得到相同的摘要和计数。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、export_tenant 的签名、格式、错误类型、并发快照及损坏前序拒绝行为保持不变。
41	
42	记录序号 `seq` 的校验是严格的 JSON 整数校验：append 系列只产生从 1 开始连续递增的整数序号，因此历史中每条记录的 `seq` 必须是不带小数和指数表示的 JSON 整数，且恰好等于该租户下一个期望序号。`1.0`、`1e0`、`1E0`、`10e-1` 等浮点拼写（即使宿主语言宽松相等成立）、`true`/`false`、字符串、`null`、数组、对象，以及任何不等于期望值的整数（含负数与零），统一判为 `sequence` 损坏；缺少 `seq` 字段或整行不可解析仍判 `missing`，分类优先级不变。该规则在 append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、append_many_if_heads、import_tenant、verify、verify_all、head、heads、read_tenant、export_tenant、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes 全部公开入口一致生效，文件扫描与内存扫描对同一损坏行给出相同结论：`sequence` 错误把期望序号、租户与物理行号填入 `AuditChainStateError`（verify 系结果继续使用现有 `ok`/`at`/`tenant`/`reason` 结构），物理顺序上更早的 missing/sequence/digest 优先，`expected_count` 对合法历史的短缺/超额语义不变。非法序号不会被重编号、跳过、重写或当作另一租户：任何写入入口遇到该状态都拒绝追加且保持原字节不变，`import_tenant` 对含非法序号的输入或目标同样整体失败、不留部分导入；非法调用参数仍在读取历史之前以 `ValueError` 结束。
43	`export_tenant_chunks(tenant, chunk_size)` 与 `export_all_chunks(chunk_size)` 是面向大历史的分块离线导出入口，分别是 `export_tenant`/`export_all` 的分块版本：不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络，也不写额外落盘元数据。两者都返回一个产生 `bytes` 的迭代器，按顺序产出的分块拼接后分别与同一份快照上 `export_tenant(tenant)`、`export_all()` 的返回值**逐字节相等**；分块只按字节偏移切分，可切在任意 UTF-8 序列、JSON 对象或换行中间，最后一块可以更短，空历史（日志不存在、为空，或目标租户无记录）产出空迭代（零个分块）。tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；`chunk_size` 必须是正的普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，`0`、负数、浮点、字符串及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），所有边界错误在产生迭代器或读取历史之前抛出。整次导出固定于一个完整快照：在同一次只读共享锁快照上先完成与对应非分块入口完全相同的全链校验（单租户即 `verify(tenant)` 的扫描，全日志即 `verify_all` 的物理顺序扫描），**首块产生之前**校验必须全部通过；源历史损坏时不产出任何分块，改抛 `AuditChainStateError`，其 tenant、seq、reason、line 与 `export_tenant`/`export_all` 完全一致，并发追加只能让各次导出对应某次追加之前或之后的完整快照。
44	
45	`import_tenant_chunks(tenant, chunks)` 与 `import_all_chunks(chunks)` 是对应的分块离线导入入口，分别是 `import_tenant`/`import_all` 的大历史版本：调用方按顺序提供一个 `bytes` 分块可迭代对象，单个 `bytes` 或 `bytearray` 不能被当作容器（其迭代会产出整数，统一 `ValueError`），不可迭代容器或任何非 `bytes`（`bytearray` 元素同样拒绝）成员也是 `ValueError`，遇到首个坏成员立即停止消费后续分块；空分块允许，空可迭代或仅含空分块等价于空内容。分块只按字节拼接，可切在任意字节位置（UTF-8、JSON、换行中间），只有按序拼接后的整段才被解析。二者分别接受现有 `import_tenant`、`import_all` 可接受的完整内容，字段、优先级与字节入口完全一致：`import_tenant_chunks` 的 tenant 沿用标准 JSON 边界，混入其他规范 JSON 身份租户抛 `ValueError`；非法 JSONL、缺字段、顺序或摘要错误抛带输入物理行号的 `AuditChainStateError`，目标涉及租户已有记录抛 `AuditChainConflictError`（固定空链期望、actual_* 反映租约内尾部），且一切输入问题严格优先于目标状态。空拼接在边界校验通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读取历史、不改字节。成功时按物理顺序返回与对应字节入口**相同的记录对象**（保留 tenant/seq/event/prev/hash 原值），并把整段内容作为**一次不可分提交**写入（末行缺换行沿用 append 的补换行规则）；任何输入或目标失败都不写入部分字节，持共享锁的并发读取者只能看到提交前或提交后的完整状态，竞争同一空链头的分块导入在同一排他租约上串行、恰有一个获胜。新接口不依赖网络、远端锚定或额外落盘元数据；所有既有追加、条件头、分页读取、verify 系列、范围迁移及非分块导入导出的行为、签名、返回值、异常字段、租户隔离与规范 JSONL 字节格式保持不变。
46

# Audit Chain

A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, audit, transaction-graph.

Run with: python3 demo.py
Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Scope

实现按租户分区的追加审计日志：每条记录包含租户、顺序号、事件和前一条摘要，读取方可以离线校验完整历史并定位第一个损坏的位置。追加必须拒绝错误的前序状态，校验结果要明确区分缺失、顺序错误和摘要错误；日志格式保持可迁移，不依赖网络服务或远端锚定。

租户身份按稳定的 JSON 数据身份划分（`json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)`）：对象键顺序不影响身份，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 是四个互不相干的租户；append、verify、verify_all 共用同一套分区语义。

输入与读取都遵循标准 JSON 边界：append 的 tenant 和 event 只能由 null、布尔值、有限整数/浮点数、字符串、数组和键为字符串的对象递归组成，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串键及无法无歧义编码的值一律抛出 `ValueError`（先于任何追加动作，不写入任何字节）。verify 的 tenant 参数采用同一定义：非法值在读取历史或触碰路径之前抛出 `ValueError`（不泄露 TypeError/RecursionError 或 JSON 编码异常），已损坏的文件与非法 tenant 同时出现时同样是 `ValueError` 优先且字节不变；合法 tenant 的校验结果（missing/sequence/digest 及 expected_count 语义）保持不变。verify/verify_all 以同一规则解释历史：包含重复对象键、NaN/Infinity/-Infinity 或其他非标准 JSON 内容的物理行按 missing 类损坏处理并停在首次出现处。

同一路径可被多个线程或进程同时读写而仍保持单一可验证历史：append 在整个"读取最新状态—计算 seq/prev/hash—追加"区间持有排他文件锁（`flock`，无第三方依赖），因此每条记录都基于其真正落盘前的最新完整状态计算，任何调用都不会覆盖既有字节；verify/verify_all 持共享锁读取，只会看到某次追加之前或之后完整自洽的文件视图，绝不会把写了一半的记录报成损坏。历史一旦损坏，并发 append 仍以相同的 tenant/seq/line/reason（missing、sequence、digest 之一）抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 且不改动文件。旧版 JSONL 文件格式不变，可继续直接验证。

`append_batch(tenant, events)` 一次提交一组同租户事件：events 必须是列表（空列表直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不改动字节；其他类型一律 `ValueError`），租户与列表中每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界。成功时按输入顺序分配连续 seq——首条接在该租户当前链末（prev 为提交前最后一条记录的摘要），后续逐条引用批次内前一条摘要——并在同一次排他租约内以一个字节块整体追加，因此整批对其他追加/校验是一个不可分割的可见结果：同租户追加只能整体落在批前或批后，不同租户仍可交错且各自从 1 计数。落盘为每行一个 JSON 对象，与逐条调用 append 产生的字节和 verify/verify_all 计数、摘要、首个错误位置完全一致；扫描到与 append 相同的首个损坏点时抛出同样字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）的 `AuditChainStateError`，失败不留任何部分记录。

`append_if_head(tenant, event, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是带前序断言的单条条件追加：调用方给出链头应有的记录数和末条摘要，只有二者与租约内实际读到的链头**同时**相等时才追加下一条。`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool`、负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链的期望摘要使用现有 `ZERO`。tenant、event 继续沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；所有非法值（含布尔计数、负数计数、格式不正确的摘要）都在读取日志或创建文件之前以 `ValueError` 结束，不创建、不修改日志。成功时返回值与 append 完全相同（同一记录 dict、同样的五个字段、seq、prev 与摘要算法），落盘字节与对相同历史调用 append 逐字节一致。断言格式合法但与当前链头不符时抛出新增的 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash` 五个字段，且 `reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`；`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`，历史为空（日志不存在、为空或只含其他租户记录）时按同一规则比较，失败调用不写入任何字节——对尚不存在的日志作出非空断言尤其不会创建日志文件。历史损坏时沿用 `AuditChainStateError`：tenant、seq、line、reason 语义与 append/verify/export 完全一致，reason 仍只取 missing、sequence、digest，错误优先级与文件字节不变，且状态错误优先于冲突判定（不会拿不可验证的链去比较断言）。校验、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：日志已存在时使用与 append 相同的数据文件排他锁；日志尚不存在时，排他目录取锁（普通 append 创建文件时同样短暂持有该锁）覆盖"探测不存在—空链比较—创建文件"整段，且文件只在断言获胜后才被创建，加锁顺序始终是目录锁先于文件锁，不会与普通 append 死锁。因此并发提交同一个链头时至多一个成功，其余调用都在锁内观察到获胜者写入的新链头并得到确定的冲突异常（actual_* 反映获胜后的真实计数与末条摘要）。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果、JSONL 格式、租户身份区分及离线行为保持不变。

`append_batch_if_head(tenant, events, expected_count, expected_hash)` 把批量追加与头部断言合并为一次原子提交：events 必须是列表（其他类型一律 `ValueError`；空列表在全部参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读写任何字节，头部断言不被求值），tenant 与每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界，`expected_count`/`expected_hash` 的边界与 append_if_head 完全一致（非负普通整数、拒绝 bool；恰好 64 个小写十六进制字符，空链用 `ZERO`），所有非法值都在读取历史或触碰路径之前统一抛 `ValueError`。events 非空时，扫描、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：先以与 append 完全相同的规则校验该租户从第一条到链尾的完整链，再同时比较实际记录数与末条摘要，二者都匹配才追加。成功时返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表（tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五字段），首条 seq 为 `expected_count + 1`、prev 为 `expected_hash`，后续记录在批次内部连续链接，整批作为一个不可分割的字节区间一次落盘——其他租户的追加只能整体落在批前或批后，持共享锁的读取方只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照；落盘字节与对同一链头逐条调用 append（或一次 append_batch）得到的历史逐字节一致。日志尚不存在时只有 `(0, ZERO)` 断言的非空批次可以创建文件，其余非空断言抛 `AuditChainConflictError`（actual 为 `(0, ZERO)`）且不创建文件；已存在日志上的头部不匹配同样抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`。扫描发现缺失、顺序错误或摘要错误时优先抛 `AuditChainStateError`（tenant、seq、reason、物理行号语义与 append 一致，状态错误优先于冲突判定）；冲突与状态错误路径都不写入任何部分记录。并发调用共享同一链头时至多一个批次成功，其余调用在锁内观察到获胜批次之后的新链头并得到携带实际值的冲突异常。功能不依赖网络或远端锚定；append、append_batch、append_if_head、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果与异常边界保持不变。

`append_many(entries)` 是跨租户的原子追加入口：entries 必须是列表，每项必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`event` 两个键的对象（参数不是列表、成员不是对象、缺键、多键或键集合不符一律 `ValueError`；非字符串成员键同样拒绝），列表顺序就是记录的写入顺序。每个 tenant 与 event 沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；列表形状、成员形状、键集合以及全部 tenant/event 在触碰路径、读取历史或加锁之前完成校验，任何边界错误都统一为 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节（即使目标日志已损坏也不读取）。空列表在参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建、不读取也不改变日志。非空调用在一次排他租约内读取一致快照，对本次涉及的每个租户执行与 append 完全相同的完整链扫描——序号从 1 起连续、prev 与当前链头衔接、每条 hash 可重算——缺失/无法解析为 `missing`、顺序错误为 `sequence`、prev 或 hash 不一致为 `digest`，抛出字段（tenant、seq、reason、物理行号）与 append 完全一致的 `AuditChainStateError`；多个受影响链同时有问题时，按日志中首次出现的物理行确定结果，物理行相同再按输入的首次出现顺序确定；任何校验失败都不写入部分记录、字节保持不变，未涉及租户自身的损坏不阻止本次提交。全部前序状态有效后，同一租户在列表中可出现多次，其记录按出现顺序连续编号（首条接该租户提交前的链尾，后续逐条引用本组内前一条摘要），其他租户各自从当前链尾继续；返回与输入一一对应的记录 dict 列表，每项保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个字段，物理 JSONL 顺序与输入顺序一致，摘要与前序摘要规则、序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）与换行补全规则与 append 完全相同——落盘字节与按输入顺序逐条调用 append 逐字节一致。全部生成记录作为一个不可分割的追加区块一次写入：持共享锁的并发读取只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照，竞争写入在同一租约上串行、整体落在区块之前或之后且不会覆盖既有字节，其他租户的合法交错记录继续保留；目标文件不存在时仅在校验成功后才创建。生成的日志可由现有 verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、read_tenant、export_tenant 与离线字节校验直接验证，import_tenant 的既有空链冲突语义保持不变。功能不依赖网络或远端锚定；JSONL 字段、租户身份区分、摘要算法、错误类型与既有入口的签名、返回值及行为保持兼容。

`append_many_if_heads(entries)` 把跨租户原子追加与每租户链头断言合并为一次离线原子提交，相当于 `append_many` 的不可分割分组提交与每租户一个 `append_batch_if_head` 式头部断言的融合：entries 必须是列表，每项必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`events`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash` 四个键的对象（参数不是列表、成员不是对象、缺键、多键或键集合不符一律 `ValueError`；非字符串成员键同样拒绝）；events 必须是非空列表（非列表或空列表一律 `ValueError`——空 `entries` 列表才是校验通过后的空操作），其每个事件沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链断言使用现有 `ZERO`；同一规范 JSON 身份的 tenant 在整个 entries 中至多出现一次，重复（含仅对象键顺序不同但身份相同）一律 `ValueError`，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 等不同 JSON 身份仍是互不相关的租户。列表形状、成员形状、键集合、events 非空、计数/摘要格式、租户唯一性以及全部 tenant/event 的标准 JSON 边界都在加锁、探测路径或读取任何字节之前完成，任何非法输入统一抛 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节，即使目标日志已损坏也不读取。空列表在全部校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建、不读取也不改变日志，头部断言不被求值。非空调用在一次排他租约内读取一致快照，只对本次涉及的每个租户执行与 append 完全相同的完整链扫描——只验证涉及租户从 seq=1 到链尾的顺序、prev 与每条 hash，缺失或无法解析为 `missing`、序号错误为 `sequence`、前序或当前摘要不符为 `digest`，并以 `AuditChainStateError` 的 tenant、seq、line、reason 字段报告；多个涉及链同时损坏时按物理行号优先、输入首次出现顺序打破平局（与 append_many 完全一致），未涉及租户的损坏忽略。任何状态错误都不拿不可验证的链去比较断言、不写入任何字节。涉及链状态全部有效后，按 entries 顺序依次比较每个断言的计数与末条摘要，首个不符项（无论租户）按 entries 顺序抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开该租户的 `expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`，`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`；状态错误严格优先于冲突，冲突路径同样不写入任何字节。日志不存在时，只有**全部**断言都是 `(0, ZERO)` 才能创建文件；否则按 entries 顺序首个非空/错摘要断言在目录租约内确定性地抛出 actual 为 `(0, ZERO)` 的冲突，且不创建任何文件。全部断言匹配时，按 entries 顺序、每个 entry 内按 events 顺序生成并返回五字段记录（tenant、seq、event、prev、hash）列表：每个租户从其断言链尾（首条 prev 为 `expected_hash`）连续编号，同一 entry 的多条事件在批次内连续链接，字段、摘要算法、规范化序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）、末行缺换行时补换行及租户身份规则与 append_batch、append_many 完全一致，落盘字节与对相同链头按相同 entry/event 顺序逐条调用 append 逐字节一致；所有记录作为不可分割 JSONL 区块一次追加，其他租户的合法交错记录继续保留。并发提交在同一排他租约上串行：竞争相同/相交链头的调用至多一个成功，其余在锁内观察到获胜者写入后的新链头并得到携带获胜后实际计数与末条摘要的确定冲突，持共享锁的读取方只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照，绝不会看到半个区块。生成的日志可由 append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、read_tenant、export_tenant/import_tenant 直接继续追加、校验、分页读取与离线迁移；功能不依赖网络或远端锚定，既有入口的签名、返回值、异常字段与可迁移 JSONL 格式保持兼容。

`export_tenant(tenant)` 面向离线迁移，按租户导出单链：返回 UTF-8 编码的 `bytes`，本身不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，也不访问网络；调用方自行把返回字节写入新的 JSONL 路径后，新的 `AuditChain` 可直接用现有 verify/verify_all 离线验证。tenant 采用与 append/verify 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界，非法值在读取任何历史之前统一抛 `ValueError` 且不读取、不创建文件。导出在单次只读共享锁快照中完成：先运行与 `verify(tenant)` 相同的完整扫描，整份快照对该租户有效后才开始拼装结果，因此源状态错误统一抛 `AuditChainStateError`（填入目标 tenant、首个应检查的 seq、reason 与物理行号），绝不会先返回已收集的前缀；reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest，优先级与行号沿用现有校验规则。源文件不存在或为空是合法空快照，成功返回 `b""`。导出内容只包含目标租户在源文件中按物理顺序出现的记录（其他租户的交错记录被丢弃且不导致重排），每行一个 JSON 对象，沿用 append 的序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）与换行规则，字段、值、seq、prev、hash 与源历史语义一致；JSON 身份不同的租户（如 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"`）各自独立导出、互不混入。快照未变更时重复调用得到字节完全相同的结果；并发追加期间，导出只能观察到某次追加之前或之后的完整快照，失败时不写入任何字节。

`import_tenant(tenant, data)` 是 `export_tenant` 的离线反向入口：把一段单租户 JSONL 历史（通常来自另一条日志的导出字节）整体移植/灾备恢复到本日志，全程不依赖网络或远端锚定。调用先于任何历史读取、路径探测和加锁完成参数边界校验：tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界（NaN/Infinity、非字符串键、循环容器及无标准 JSON 编码的值一律 `ValueError`），`data` 必须是 `bytes`（`str`、`bytearray` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），参数边界错误优先于一切历史状态处理，且不创建文件、不改字节。`data` 为空 `b""` 时在校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建文件、不读取历史、不改变任何字节（即使目标日志已损坏也不读取）。非空 `data` 必须是严格 UTF-8、每行一个标准 JSON 对象的单租户历史；在触碰目标之前先完整校验整条输入链——从 `seq=1`、`prev=ZERO` 起逐行确认必需字段、连续顺序与摘要：解析失败、重复键、非标准数字、非法 UTF-8 或缺字段抛 `AuditChainStateError`、reason 为 `missing`，顺序错误为 `sequence`，prev 或 hash 不一致为 `digest`，并准确填充 tenant、seq 与物理行号（行号与优先级规则与 append/verify/export 完全一致）；混入任何其他规范 JSON 身份的租户记录（含交错的其他租户、`1` 与 `"1"` 这类不同身份）违反单租户输入契约，统一抛 `ValueError`。随后在同一次受保护操作（与 append 相同的数据文件排他租约；目标不存在时经目录租约原子创建）内校验目标文件：目标租户已有任何记录即抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，固定 `expected_count=0`、`expected_hash=ZERO`，`actual_count`/`actual_hash` 反映租约内观察到的目标尾部（含其他租户交错后的该租户真实尾摘要）；目标历史损坏时优先返回与 append 完全相同的 `AuditChainStateError`（状态错误优先于冲突判定），其他租户自身的摘要损坏不影响导入。任何失败路径都不写入部分记录、不改变既有字节。成功时把整段历史作为一个不可分割的字节块一次追加（目标最后一行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则），记录原有的 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 原样保留——既不重编号也不重算摘要，首条仍以 `ZERO` 为锚；返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表（恰含五个现有字段及其输入原值）。目标文件可已包含其他租户的有效交错记录，导入后 verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 均按现有规则通过，且该租户可直接用 append/append_if_head 从导入尾部继续；JSON 身份不同的租户互不可见、互不冲突。并发导入/追加同租户时，写操作在同一排他租约上串行：至多一次导入成功提交完整区块，其余调用要么观察到该租户非空链头而得到携带实际尾部的冲突，要么在导入之前成功并让随后的导入冲突；共享锁读取方只能看到整段导入之前或之后的完整快照。append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、返回值、异常字段、租户身份区分、并发快照与 JSONL 可迁移格式保持不变。

`export_all()` 与 `import_all(data)` 是整份日志快照的离线迁移入口，分别对应 export_tenant/import_tenant 的全日志版本，JSONL 格式、摘要算法、租户身份规则与既有入口完全不变。`export_all()` 只读返回当前日志的 UTF-8 `bytes`：不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络；日志不存在或为空是合法空快照，返回 `b""`。返回前在同一次只读共享锁快照上按物理顺序验证所有租户的全部链（每个租户自首次出现起独立从 seq=1、prev=ZERO 校验，规则与 verify_all 一致）：物理行无法按严格 UTF-8 和标准 JSON 解析、含重复键或非标准数字，或任一租户出现缺字段、顺序错误、前序摘要错误或当前摘要错误时，不返回任何部分结果，改抛 `AuditChainStateError`（reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest），以 tenant、seq、reason、line 定位物理顺序上的首次损坏——无法确定租户的行（不可解析、非对象、无 tenant 键）tenant 与 seq 为 None。验证通过后逐字节返回快照原文（含租户交错顺序），并发追加期间导出只能对应完整的追加前或追加后视图。`import_all(data)` 接收多租户交错的 JSONL 字节：`data` 不是 `bytes` 时在读取目标之前抛 `ValueError`；空 `bytes` 在类型检查通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读历史、不改字节。非空输入先在内存中完整验证：允许租户交错，但每个租户的链都从 seq=1、prev=ZERO 起连续，每条记录恰含 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个既有字段且摘要可重算；解析失败、缺字段或多字段、重复键、非标准数字、非法 UTF-8 按 missing，序号问题按 sequence，prev 或 hash 不符按 digest，均抛带输入物理行号的 `AuditChainStateError`，物理顺序上首个损坏行决定结果。输入验证通过后，目标检查与提交在同一次排他租约内作为一次原子操作完成，且只检查输入涉及的租户：目标链损坏优先抛与 append 相同字段的 `AuditChainStateError`（多链同时损坏按目标物理行优先、输入首次出现顺序打破平局）；涉及租户已有记录时按输入首次出现顺序抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，`expected_count` 固定为 0、`expected_hash` 固定为 `ZERO`，`actual_count`/`actual_hash` 反映租约内观察到的该租户尾部；任何失败路径都不写入字节。全部涉及链为空时，才把规范化 JSONL（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`，每行一条记录）作为一个不可分割区块一次追加，目标末行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则，目标不存在时仅在校验通过后创建；成功返回按输入物理顺序排列、保留原值的记录 dict 列表。竞争导入或追加在同一租约上串行，共享锁读取方只能看到完整提交前或提交后的状态。append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、append_many_if_heads、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、import_tenant、read_tenant、head、heads 的签名、返回值、异常字段与既有语义保持不变。

`export_tenant_range(tenant, start_seq, end_seq=None)` 与 `import_tenant_range(tenant, data, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是非空链的分段迁移入口：归档或灾备恢复可以从一个已知链头继续，而不必每次搬运整份历史；五字段记录、seq 编号与摘要算法与既有入口完全一致。`export_tenant_range` 只读返回目标租户闭区间 `[start_seq, end_seq]` 的 UTF-8 JSONL `bytes`（`end_seq=None` 表示到链尾），不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络；记录原样保留磁盘上的 prev 与 hash，因此首条记录的 prev 仍指向被省略的前序链头。tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 相同的标准 JSON 边界，`start_seq` 必须是正的普通整数（拒绝 bool、浮点及其他类型），`end_seq` 必须是 `None` 或不小于 `start_seq` 的普通整数，非法边界在读取任何历史之前抛 `ValueError`。导出在单次只读共享锁快照中先以与 `verify(tenant)` 完全相同的规则完整校验该租户整条链——源历史损坏抛与 append/verify/export_tenant 相同字段的 `AuditChainStateError`，即使请求区间完全位于损坏点之前也绝不返回已验证前缀——校验通过后才在内存中截取闭区间。空链（日志不存在、为空或该租户无记录）或范围超出链尾（`start_seq` 大于当前条数，或显式 `end_seq` 大于当前条数）抛新增的 `AuditChainRangeError`，公开 `tenant`、`start_seq`、`end_seq`（按调用原值，未给 `end_seq` 时为 `None`）、`count`（快照内验证过的链长），`reason` 固定为 `"range"`，且不返回任何字节。`import_tenant_range` 是反向入口：先校验参数——tenant 标准 JSON 边界、`data` 只能是 `bytes`、`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（拒绝 bool）、`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（空链断言用 `ZERO`）——非法值在读取前抛 `ValueError`；空 `bytes` 在校验通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读历史、不改字节。非空输入在触碰目标之前完整校验：严格 UTF-8 JSONL、每条物理行都是同一规范 JSON 身份租户且**恰好**含五个既有字段（多字段同样按 missing 处理）、seq 从 `expected_count + 1` 起连续递增、第一条 prev 等于 `expected_hash`、每条 hash 可重算；缺失/顺序/摘要错误分别以 `missing`/`sequence`/`digest` 报告首个物理行（`AuditChainStateError`，tenant/seq/line 填充规则与 append 一致），混入其他租户身份违反单租户输入契约抛 `ValueError`。随后在原子提交中（与 append_if_head 相同的租约：已存在日志用数据文件排他锁，不存在时目录租约覆盖"探测—空链比较—创建"整段）先以与 append 完全相同的规则校验目标完整链——目标损坏优先抛 `AuditChainStateError`——再同时比较实际 count 与末条 hash，二者都与断言匹配才把整段作为一个不可分割字节块追加（末行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则）并返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表；断言不符抛带 `actual_count`、`actual_hash` 的 `AuditChainConflictError`（`reason` 固定 `"conflict"`），目标不存在时只有 `(0, ZERO)` 断言可创建文件，其余非空断言确定性冲突且不创建文件；任何失败路径都不写入字节。并发提交在同一租约上串行：至多一个获胜，其余在锁内观察到获胜后的真实链头并得到携带实际值的冲突。既有入口（append 系列、verify 系列、export_tenant/export_all/import_tenant/import_all、read_tenant、head/heads）的签名、返回值、异常字段、并发快照与可迁移 JSONL 格式保持不变。

`import_all_range(data, expected_heads)` 是多租户分段迁移入口：把多个租户从各自已知链头开始的 JSONL 片段（通常由若干次 export_tenant_range 产生，允许租户交错）在一次离线原子提交中追加到本日志，是 import_tenant_range 的跨租户版本，也是 import_all 从已知头部续写而非空链嫁接的推广。记录原样保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash——既不重编号也不重算摘要——因此 verify/verify_all/verify_bytes/verify_all_bytes 与 export 系列按既有规则即可校验合并后的日志。参数边界先于一切：`data` 必须是 `bytes`（`str`、`bytearray` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_heads` 必须是列表（其他类型一律 `ValueError`），每个成员必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash` 三个键的对象（缺键、多键、键集合不符或非字符串成员键同样拒绝）；tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界，`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（空链断言用现有 `ZERO`）；同一规范 JSON 身份的 tenant 在整个 expected_heads 中至多出现一次（仅对象键顺序不同但身份相同同样 `ValueError`），而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 仍是互不相干的租户。所有形状、键集合、租户/计数/摘要格式与唯一性校验都在加锁、探测路径或读取任何字节之前完成，任何非法输入统一抛 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节，即使目标日志已损坏也不读取。`data` 为空 `b""` 时在全部参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建文件、不读取历史、不改变任何字节，头部断言不被求值。非空输入在触碰目标之前先在内存中完整校验：严格 UTF-8 JSONL，输入允许租户交错，但每租户首条 `seq=expected_count+1`、`prev=expected_hash`，之后连续递增；每条物理行必须是恰含 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个既有字段的对象，且每条 hash 按现有算法可重算；每个被列出的租户至少出现一条记录。解析失败、重复键、非标准数字、空行、非对象、缺字段或多字段、非法 UTF-8、以及缺记录的已列出租户抛 `AuditChainStateError`、reason 为 `missing`；序号问题为 `sequence`；prev/hash 不符为 `digest`；异常携带 tenant、seq、line（输入物理行号），无法确定租户时 tenant 与 seq 为 `None`；出现未列入 expected_heads 的其他规范 JSON 身份租户记录违反输入契约，按物理行首个决定的优先级抛 `ValueError`（与 import_tenant 的外来租户规则一致）；多处问题按物理行首个决定（输入问题整体优先于目标状态），输入校验失败不读取目标、不写入任何字节。随后目标扫描、断言比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成（与 append_many_if_heads 相同的租约：已存在日志用数据文件排他锁，日志不存在时目录租约覆盖"探测—空链比较—创建"整段）：只扫描本次涉及租户的目标链，未涉及租户的损坏忽略；目标损坏优先抛与 append 字段相同的 `AuditChainStateError`（多链同时损坏按目标物理行号优先、expected_heads 顺序打破平局），绝不拿不可验证的链去比较断言。涉及链全部有效后，按 expected_heads 顺序依次比较 count 与末条 hash，首个不符项抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开该租户的 `expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`，`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`；冲突路径不写入任何字节。目标不存在时只有**全部**断言都是 `(0, ZERO)` 才能创建文件，否则按列表顺序首个非空/错摘要断言确定性地以 actual `(0, ZERO)` 冲突返回且不留任何文件。成功时按输入物理顺序返回保留原值的记录 dict 列表，以现有规范 JSONL（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`，末行缺换行时补换行）作为一个不可分割区块一次追加，不重编号、不重算；其他租户已在盘上的合法交错记录继续保留，持共享锁的读取方只见提交前或提交后的完整快照。并发提交在同一排他租约上串行：竞争相同/相交链头的调用至多一个成功，其余在锁内观察到获胜者写入后的真实链头并得到携带实际值的确定冲突。生成的日志可由 append 系列、verify 系列、read_tenant、export/import 系列直接继续追加、校验、分页读取与离线迁移；功能不依赖网络或远端锚定，既有入口的签名、返回值、异常字段、租户身份、JSONL 字节语义与本地离线约束保持不变。

`verify_bytes(data, tenant, expected_count=None)` 与 `verify_all_bytes(data)` 是纯内存离线校验入口：调用方把 JSONL 历史的原始 `bytes` 直接传入（`export_tenant` 导出的单租户字节，或包含交错租户的完整日志均可），入口绝不读取、创建或修改构造器所指向的路径，也不依赖网络、远端锚定或其他服务；结果只依据传入快照，调用期间不修改 `data`。两个入口复用与 verify/verify_all 完全相同的 JSON 标准化、租户身份与摘要算法逐行校验，因此返回结构、reason 分类（missing/sequence/digest）、`at` 口径、租户首次出现顺序与计数与文件入口逐字节一致；空 `bytes` 是成功的空历史（`verify_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "count": 0}`，`verify_all_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "tenants": []}`），且不创建任何文件。空行、非对象、缺字段、重复键、非标准数字（NaN/Infinity/溢出数）、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON 解析失败一律按 missing 处理，能定位的物理行使用行号；seq 不连续为 sequence，prev 或 hash 不符为 digest；其他租户的坏行同样会被发现，且更早的错误优先。`verify_bytes` 的 expected_count 短缺报 missing、超额报 sequence，与 verify 同口径；`data` 不是 `bytes`（含 `bytearray`/`str` 等）、tenant 越过标准 JSON 边界（NaN/Infinity、非字符串键、循环容器等），或 expected_count 不是 `None` 以外的非负整数（`bool` 同样拒绝）时，在任何解析之前抛出 `ValueError`，不泄漏底层解析异常。export_tenant 生成的字节写回另一个 `AuditChain` 后，文件校验与内存校验得到相同的摘要和计数。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、export_tenant 的签名、格式、错误类型、并发快照及损坏前序拒绝行为保持不变。

13	def _validate_json_value(value, _stack=()):
14	    # Standard-JSON input boundary: only null, bool, finite int, finite
15	    # float, str, array (list) and object (dict with str keys) may cross
16	    # it, recursively. NaN/Infinity/-Infinity, non-string object keys and
17	    # anything without an unambiguous standard JSON encoding (including
18	    # cyclic containers) are rejected with ValueError.
19	    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, int, str)):
20	        return
21	    if isinstance(value, float):
22	        if not math.isfinite(value):
23	            raise ValueError(f"non-finite number is not standard JSON: {value!r}")
24	        return
25	    if isinstance(value, (list, dict)):
26	        if id(value) in _stack:
27	            raise ValueError("cyclic container cannot be encoded as standard JSON")
28	        stack = _stack + (id(value),)
29	        if isinstance(value, list):
30	            for item in value:
31	                _validate_json_value(item, stack)
32	        else:
33	            for k, v in value.items():
34	                if not isinstance(k, str):
35	                    raise ValueError(f"non-string object key is not standard JSON: {k!r}")
36	                _validate_json_value(v, stack)
37	        return
38	    raise ValueError(f"value has no standard JSON encoding: {value!r}")

177	    def __init__(self, path):

180	    @contextlib.contextmanager
181	    def _dir_lease(self):
182	        # Auxiliary exclusive lease on the containing directory itself. It
183	        # never carries data bytes; its only job is to make the moment a data
184	        # file first appears indivisible relative to a conditional append
185	        # that is allowed to create the file only on its winning branch.
186	        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
187	        dfd = os.open(self.path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
188	        try:
189	            fcntl.flock(dfd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
190	            yield
191	        finally:
192	            fcntl.flock(dfd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
193	            os.close(dfd)
194	
195	    @contextlib.contextmanager
196	    def _write_lease(self):
197	        # Exclusive lease for one read-modify-append. The same open file
198	        # description carries the lock, the history read and the final append:
199	        # flock is tied to that description, so the lease cannot be silently
200	        # lost to a second open of the path, and the bytes appended are the
201	        # ones computed from the bytes just read. A fresh fd per call makes
202	        # flock genuinely exclude both other processes and other threads.
203	        # The creating open happens inside the directory lease, so a
204	        # conditional append probing a not-yet-existing path cannot race the
205	        # file's first appearance (see append_if_head); the lease is released
206	        # again before blocking on the data file, so it never serializes
207	        # unrelated chains in the same directory for a write's duration.
208	        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
209	        with self._dir_lease():
210	            f = open(self.path, "a+b")
211	        try:
212	            fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
213	            f.seek(0)
214	            yield f
215	            # Flush while the lease is still held, so the lock is released
216	            # only after the full record has reached the kernel file.
217	            f.flush()
218	        finally:
219	            # Closing the description also releases the flock.
220	            f.close()

222	    def _read_snapshot(self):
223	        # One complete, self-consistent read-only view, protected by a shared
224	        # lease on the data file itself. The file is opened O_RDONLY, so a
225	        # verify never creates the path: when it does not exist yet that is a
226	        # legitimate pre-append view and yields empty bytes. Under the shared
227	        # lock no append can be mid-flight, so the snapshot is always the full
228	        # state either before or after some append, never a partial record.
229	        try:
230	            f = open(self.path, "rb")
231	        except FileNotFoundError:
232	            return b""
233	        try:
234	            fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_SH)
235	            return f.read()
236	        finally:
237	            fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
238	            f.close()

245	        # preceding any corruption (all lines when the file is valid UTF-8),
246	        # bad_line is the 1-based line number of the first undecodable line
247	        # or None. A bad line is never yielded, even if the bytes before the
248	        # illegal byte looked like complete JSON: callers scan the preceding
249	        # complete lines first, so an earlier JSON/sequence/digest error

253	        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:

262	    def _tenant_key(tenant):
263	        # Canonical JSON data identity of a tenant value. Object key order is
264	        # normalized away, while distinct JSON types or number spellings stay
265	        # distinct partitions: 1, 1.0, true and "1" are four different
266	        # tenants regardless of host-language loose equality.
267	        return json.dumps(tenant, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))

269	    @staticmethod
270	    def _hash(item):
271	        payload = json.dumps(
272	            {k: item[k] for k in ("tenant", "seq", "event", "prev")},
273	            sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
274	        )
275	        return hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

277	    def _scan(self, tenant, lines, bad_line=None):
278	        # Validate the target tenant's chain over the decoded JSONL lines.
279	        # Returns (verified_count, last_hash). Raises _Broken at the first
280	        # problem; records of other tenants may interleave and are skipped.
281	        # Tenant matching uses the same canonical JSON identity as
282	        # verify_all, never host-language loose equality. If bad_line is
283	        # given, an undecodable physical line follows the lines provided;
284	        # it is reported as missing only when no earlier problem was found.
285	        key = self._tenant_key(tenant)
286	        expected, prev, count = 1, ZERO, 0
287	        for line, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
288	            try:
289	                item = _strict_loads(raw)
290	            except Exception:
291	                raise _Broken("missing", None, line, expected)
292	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or "tenant" not in item:
293	                raise _Broken("missing", None, line, expected)
294	            if self._tenant_key(item["tenant"]) != key:
295	                continue
296	            if any(k not in item for k in FIELDS):
297	                seq = item.get("seq")
298	                at = seq if isinstance(seq, int) and not isinstance(seq, bool) else None
299	                raise _Broken("missing", at, line, expected)
300	            seq = item["seq"]
301	            # The seq of a stored record must be a JSON integer exactly equal
302	            # to the next expected one: append only ever writes plain ints,
303	            # so a bool, a float spelling (1.0, 1e0 -- host-language loose
304	            # equality must not admit them), a string, null, an array/object
305	            # or any mismatching integer is a sequence defect, never a valid
306	            # record, and is never renumbered, skipped or rewritten.
307	            if isinstance(seq, bool) or not isinstance(seq, int) \
308	                    or seq != expected:
309	                raise _Broken("sequence", expected, line, expected)
310	            if item["prev"] != prev:
311	                raise _Broken("digest", expected, line, expected)
312	            if item["hash"] != self._hash(item):
313	                raise _Broken("digest", expected, line, expected)
314	            count += 1
315	            prev = item["hash"]
316	            expected += 1
317	        if bad_line is not None:
318	            raise _Broken("missing", None, bad_line, expected)
319	        return count, prev

414	    def _scan_all_chains(self, lines, bad_line=None, exact_fields=False):
415	        # Validate every tenant chain over decoded JSONL lines in one
416	        # physical-order pass, records of different tenants interleaving
417	        # freely. Each tenant gets an independent expected seq and prev
418	        # digest starting at (1, ZERO) on first appearance -- the per-tenant
419	        # rules _scan applies, evaluated for all tenants at once the way
420	        # verify_all does. Returns the parsed records in physical order.
421	        # The first defective physical line raises AuditChainStateError
422	        # directly, with tenant/seq/reason/line filled exactly the way the
423	        # _scan/_Broken path fills them for a single tenant; a line whose
424	        # tenant cannot be determined at all (unparseable, non-object, no
425	        # "tenant" key) reports tenant None and seq None. With
426	        # exact_fields=True a record must carry exactly the five FIELDS keys
427	        # (the import_all input contract); otherwise only missing keys are
428	        # defects, matching the file-scan rule every other entry point uses.
429	        # If bad_line is given, an undecodable physical line follows the
430	        # lines provided; it is reported as missing only when no earlier
431	        # problem was found.
432	        states = {}  # serialized tenant -> [expected_seq, prev_hash]
433	        records = []
434	        for line, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
435	            try:
436	                item = _strict_loads(raw)
437	            except Exception:
438	                raise AuditChainStateError(None, None, "missing", line) from None
439	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or "tenant" not in item:
440	                raise AuditChainStateError(None, None, "missing", line) from None
441	            tenant = item["tenant"]
442	            key = self._tenant_key(tenant)
443	            state = states.get(key)
444	            if state is None:
445	                state = [1, ZERO]
446	                states[key] = state
447	            expected, prev = state
448	            if exact_fields:
449	                malformed = set(item) != set(FIELDS)
450	            else:
451	                malformed = any(k not in item for k in FIELDS)
452	            if malformed:
453	                seq = item.get("seq")
454	                at = seq if isinstance(seq, int) \
455	                    and not isinstance(seq, bool) else expected
456	                raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, at, "missing", line) from None
457	            seq = item["seq"]
458	            # Same strict JSON-integer seq rule as _scan: 1.0/1e0, bools,
459	            # strings, null, arrays/objects and mismatching integers are all
460	            # sequence defects, so this scan agrees with every other entry.
461	            if isinstance(seq, bool) or not isinstance(seq, int) \
462	                    or seq != expected:
463	                raise AuditChainStateError(
464	                    tenant, expected, "sequence", line) from None
465	            if item["prev"] != prev:
466	                raise AuditChainStateError(
467	                    tenant, expected, "digest", line) from None
468	            if item["hash"] != self._hash(item):
469	                raise AuditChainStateError(
470	                    tenant, expected, "digest", line) from None
471	            state[0] += 1
472	            state[1] = item["hash"]
473	            records.append(item)
474	        if bad_line is not None:
475	            # First undecodable byte: tenant cannot be parsed, so None.
476	            raise AuditChainStateError(None, None, "missing", bad_line) from None

482	        # (tenant, expected_count, expected_hash) tuples in expected_heads

490	        # expected_count+2, ... continuously and the first prev equals the

499	        # undecodable physical line follows the lines provided and is
500	        # reported as missing only when no earlier problem was found.

502	        for tenant, count, head in assertions:

508	                item = _strict_loads(raw)

514	            key = self._tenant_key(tenant)
515	            state = states.get(key)

525	            if set(item) != set(FIELDS):
526	                seq = item.get("seq")
527	                at = seq if isinstance(seq, int) \
528	                    and not isinstance(seq, bool) else expected
529	                raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, at, "missing", line) from None
530	            seq = item["seq"]
531	            # Same strict JSON-integer seq rule as every other scan: 1.0/1e0,
532	            # bools, strings, null, arrays/objects and mismatching integers are
533	            # all sequence defects.
534	            if isinstance(seq, bool) or not isinstance(seq, int) \
535	                    or seq != expected:
536	                raise AuditChainStateError(
537	                    tenant, expected, "sequence", line) from None
538	            if item["prev"] != prev:
539	                raise AuditChainStateError(
540	                    tenant, expected, "digest", line) from None
541	            if item["hash"] != self._hash(item):
542	                raise AuditChainStateError(
543	                    tenant, expected, "digest", line) from None
544	            state[1] += 1
545	            state[2] = item["hash"]
546	            state[3] = True

550	            raise AuditChainStateError(None, None, "missing", bad_line) from None
551	        # Every listed tenant must have at least one record in the stream.
552	        for tenant, count, _head in assertions:

559	    def append(self, tenant, event):
560	        # Validate the new input against the standard-JSON boundary before
561	        # anything else: an illegal tenant/event raises ValueError without
562	        # reading history or writing a single byte, and takes priority over
563	        # any append action (including corrupt-history rejection). It is
564	        # deliberately also evaluated before taking the lock, so a malformed
565	        # caller can never be turned into a different outcome by contention.
566	        _validate_json_value(tenant)
567	        _validate_json_value(event)
568	        with self._write_lease() as f:
569	            # The scan and the write happen under one exclusive lease on the
570	            # very file description used for both, so the record is always
571	            # computed from the latest complete state right before its own
572	            # bytes hit disk: competing appends serialize here and each
573	            # observes the previous winner's record already on disk.
574	            data = f.read()
575	            lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
576	            try:
577	                count, prev = self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
578	            except _Broken as b:
579	                seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
580	                raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line) from None
581	            item = {"tenant": tenant, "seq": count + 1, "event": event, "prev": prev}
582	            item["hash"] = self._hash(item)
583	            # One O_APPEND write places the whole record atomically at the
584	            # current end of the file; under the exclusive lease no other
585	            # writer moves that end, and no existing byte can be overwritten.
586	            prefix = b"" if (not data or data.endswith(b"\n")) else b"\n"
587	            record = prefix + (
588	                json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
589	            ).encode("utf-8")
590	            f.write(record)
591	            return item

593	    def append_batch(self, tenant, events):
594	        # Append a group of same-tenant events as one verifiable interval.
595	        # events must be a list (a bare JSON value, including a string, is
596	        # not a batch); the tenant and every event cross the same standard-
597	        # JSON boundary as in append. All of this is checked before taking
598	        # the lease, so a malformed call raises ValueError without reading
599	        # history or creating the file, under any contention. An empty list
600	        # is a no-op: nothing is created and no existing byte is touched.
601	        if not isinstance(events, list):
602	            raise ValueError(
603	                f"events must be a list, got {type(events).__name__}"
604	            )
605	        _validate_json_value(tenant)
606	        for event in events:
607	            _validate_json_value(event)
608	        if not events:
609	            return []
610	        with self._write_lease() as f:
611	            # One lease covers the whole read-build-append interval, so the
612	            # batch is an indivisible result for competing writers: their
613	            # records serialize wholly before or wholly after these, never
614	            # between two of its records. The records are emitted as one
615	            # byte block at the current end of file, so readers under the
616	            # shared lease likewise see either the whole batch or none of
617	            # it. The first record continues the tenant chain found on disk;
618	            # each later record links to the previous record of the batch.
619	            data = f.read()
620	            lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
621	            try:
622	                count, prev = self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
623	            except _Broken as b:
624	                seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
625	                raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line) from None
626	            items = []
627	            chunks = []
628	            for event in events:
629	                item = {"tenant": tenant, "seq": count + 1,
630	                        "event": event, "prev": prev}
631	                item["hash"] = self._hash(item)
632	                items.append(item)
633	                chunks.append(
634	                    json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
635	                )
636	                count += 1
637	                prev = item["hash"]
638	            prefix = b"" if (not data or data.endswith(b"\n")) else b"\n"
639	            block = prefix + "".join(chunks).encode("utf-8")
640	            f.write(block)
641	            return items

643	    def _append_batch_if_head_locked(self, f, tenant, events,
644	                                     expected_count, expected_hash):
645	        # Scan, compare and append on a description already holding the
646	        # exclusive data-file lease. A corrupt history is reported exactly as
647	        # append reports it and the assertion is never evaluated against an
648	        # unverifiable chain; a well-formed but mismatching head is a conflict.
649	        # Nothing is written on either failure path.
650	        data = f.read()
651	        lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
652	        try:
653	            count, head = self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
654	        except _Broken as b:
655	            seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
656	            raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line) from None
657	        # _scan returns ZERO for an empty chain, so an empty history is
658	        # compared by the exact same rule as a non-empty one: the call
659	        # proceeds only when both the length and the tail digest match.
660	        if count != expected_count or head != expected_hash:
661	            raise AuditChainConflictError(
662	                tenant, expected_count, expected_hash, count, head
663	            )
664	        # Head confirmed. The records use the identical fields, seq numbering,
665	        # prev digest and hash algorithm as append: the first continues the
666	        # asserted chain head, each later one links to the previous record of
667	        # the batch, exactly as append_batch links its records.
668	        items = []
669	        chunks = []
670	        prev = head
671	        for event in events:
672	            item = {"tenant": tenant, "seq": count + 1,
673	                    "event": event, "prev": prev}
674	            item["hash"] = self._hash(item)
675	            items.append(item)
676	            chunks.append(
677	                json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
678	            )
679	            count += 1
680	            prev = item["hash"]
681	        # One O_APPEND write places the whole batch atomically at the
682	        # current end of file; under the exclusive lease no other writer
683	        # moves that end, and no existing byte can be overwritten.
684	        prefix = b"" if (not data or data.endswith(b"\n")) else b"\n"
685	        block = prefix + "".join(chunks).encode("utf-8")
686	        f.write(block)
687	        return items

698	    @contextlib.contextmanager
699	    def _head_lease(self, tenant, expected_count, expected_hash):
700	        # One exclusive lease covering validation-read, head comparison and
701	        # the write of a conditional append. On an existing log that is the
702	        # ordinary data-file lease; before the log exists, the data-file lock
703	        # cannot be taken without creating the path (and a losing assertion
704	        # must leave no file), so the directory lease -- the same one ordinary
705	        # appends hold while creating the file -- guards the whole
706	        # missing-file branch. The existence probe, the empty-chain
707	        # comparison and a winning creation are therefore indivisible
708	        # relative to every other writer. Lock order is always
709	        # directory-then-data, so the nesting cannot deadlock against a plain
710	        # append. _dir_lease also ensures the parent directory exists.
711	        with self._dir_lease():
712	            try:
713	                f = open(self.path, "r+b")
714	            except FileNotFoundError:
715	                # Definitive empty chain for every tenant: no other writer
716	                # can create the path while this lease is held. A non-empty
717	                # assertion is a deterministic conflict and must not create
718	                # the log; only an exact (0, ZERO) assertion may.
719	                if expected_count != 0 or expected_hash != ZERO:
720	                    raise AuditChainConflictError(
721	                        tenant, expected_count, expected_hash, 0, ZERO
722	                    )
723	                f = open(self.path, "a+b")
724	            try:
725	                fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
726	                f.seek(0)
727	                # When the file existed, assertions against the same head
728	                # serialize here: one appends and observes (count, head),
729	                # every other observes the winner's new tail and gets the
730	                # conflict with the actual values, no byte written by a
731	                # losing call. When this call just created the file the scan
732	                # confirms the empty head it was allowed to create for.
733	                yield f
734	            finally:
735	                f.flush()
736	                f.close()

738	    def append_if_head(self, tenant, event, expected_count, expected_hash):
739	        # Conditional append behind an optimistic head assertion. Every input
740	        # crosses its boundary before a lease is taken, a path is probed or a
741	        # single byte is read: tenant/event use the same standard-JSON
742	        # boundary as append, expected_count must be a non-negative plain int
743	        # (bool, negative, float and other types are ValueError), and
744	        # expected_hash must be exactly the 64 lowercase hex characters of a
745	        # sha256 digest (the empty-chain head is asserted with ZERO). A
746	        # malformed call ends here, creates nothing and never depends on
747	        # contention or history. The lease itself (and its missing-file
748	        # branch) is shared with append_batch_if_head; see _head_lease.
749	        _validate_json_value(tenant)
750	        _validate_json_value(event)
